title: Planning and Sustainable Development in Indian Context

topics.title: Meaning and approaches to planning; NITI Aayog

concepts.learning_objective: Explain planning as a process of thinking, formulating a scheme and implementing actions to achieve a goal.
Distinguish sectoral planning from regional planning.
State when and why the NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission.

topics.title: Target area planning and Hill Area Development Programme
topics.ncert_sections: Target Area Planning; Hill Area Development Programme

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why target area and target group approaches were introduced, with examples.
Describe the coverage, criteria and aims of the Hill Area Development Programmes.
Describe the objectives and changing emphasis of the Drought Prone Area Programme.
Identify how and where drought-prone areas of India were demarcated.

topics.title: Case study: Integrated Tribal Development Project in Bharmaur
topics.ncert_sections: Case Study - Integrated Tribal Development Project in Bharmaur Region

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the location, physical setting and the Gaddi community of the Bharmaur region.
Evaluate the infrastructural, social and economic outcomes of the ITDP in Bharmaur.
Trace how the concept of development evolved after World War II.
State and apply the Brundtland Report's definition of sustainable development.

topics.title: Case study: Indira Gandhi Canal command area
topics.ncert_sections: Case Study - Indira Gandhi Canal (Nahar) Command Area

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the origin, stages and flow and lift systems of the Indira Gandhi Canal.
Analyse the positive and negative impacts of canal irrigation on the command area.

topics.title: Measures for promotion of sustainable development in the IGC command area
topics.ncert_sections: Measures for Promotion of Sustainable Development

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the measures proposed to restore ecological balance in the command area.
Explain how social and economic sustainability can be achieved in the command area.
